comment: The burn option targetDisk and the install-timeline stop the USB/ISO installer posts when it can't tell which disk to erase (B2 #9; packages/flagship-builder/src/preseed.ts resolveTargetDisk). Every Studio and Android's USB burn validate the field with targetDiskPattern after trimming (empty = no option); iOS, Android and the webapp turn each stop detail into their own sentence plus the re-burn advice. kind: several | none | missing | ambiguous, or null for any other failure (shown as the box's own words).
